purpose: Release records can be read and checked (nothing releases), and workers are told how CI runs and how to report test counts honestly.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-12 the owner directed: "take this as starting point and deliver till end. Delivery this work with the AIWorks environment." The starting point is docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md (PR #12), with owner decisions D1, D3, D5 (direction only) and D9 recorded in its section 8. This campaign builds slice REL1 of docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md section 6.8 (switched off; no release is authorized) and the prompt half of monitor findings #42 and #43. Commits are published as PRs only: the supervisor never merges or deploys, and the live runtime, its data directory, the governance checkout and the scheduled tasks are never touched. No run cap or cost ceiling (AW-002); provider limits are waited out. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.

Keep AW-001 to AW-007 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open (GitHub-free local admission, Auto Release, Telegram delivery): design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #N", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.

Read GitHub with REST only (gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/issues/<n> --jq .body, .../comments, gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/pulls/<n>), never gh issue view or gh pr view: the account GraphQL quota is shared (#16, #21).

Repository CI runs npm ci and npm run check on ubuntu-latest (.github/workflows/check.yml). Every test you add or change must pass there and on Windows: guard platform-specific behaviour with a skip that names the reason, without weakening what it checks on Windows (#42). Copy the node:test summary lines (# tests, # pass, # fail, # skipped) verbatim from the output; never retype a tally (#43).

A task named after a build-order slice of docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md section 6 builds exactly that slice: its outcome, its tests and the files it lists under Owns. Section 6 decides order and file ownership; the design slice it maps to (section 6.11) decides behaviour and tests. A needed change outside the slice's files is reported as a finding, not made. Anything the slice builds switched off ships off, and with it off the full existing suite passes unchanged.

tasks.title: Read and validate a standing release record (nothing acts on it)
tasks.outcome: AIWorks reads and validates a standing release record and says why one is invalid; nothing acts on it.
tasks.goal: Build slice REL1 of docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md section 6 (read 6.2 rules, the REL1 row, 6.9 turn order and 6.12 resolutions). Outcome: AIWorks reads and validates a standing release record and says why one is invalid; nothing acts on it. Behaviour and tests: docs/design/AUTO_RELEASE.md slice R1; read that slice and the design sections it cites first. Change only the files the plan lists for REL1 under Owns. Run npm ci once, add the slice's tests, make each fail on the task base where possible (say how in the PR), then npm run check. In the PR: the slice id, what the owner gets, the tests with verbatim tallies, what stays switched off, and "Refs #13".
acceptance: Every test the plan and docs/design/AUTO_RELEASE.md slice R1 list for REL1 exists and passes; the PR says which fail on the task base and how that was shown.
Only files the plan lists for REL1 under Owns change; the PR shows the diff stat.
Switches the slice adds are off by default; with them off the full existing suite passes unchanged, and new tests are correct on Linux CI and Windows.
npm run check passes; the PR copies the node:test summary lines verbatim and states that nothing is deployed.

tasks.title: Workers know CI runs on Linux; tallies are copied, and a tally mismatch blocks
tasks.outcome: Worker and verifier prompts state that CI runs on Linux and require verbatim test tallies; a verifier treats a tally that does not match its own re-run as blocking.
tasks.goal: Fix the prompt half of #42 and #43 (gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/issues/42 and /43). In src/supervisor/adapters/executors.mjs (buildPrompt) add, for implementer and verifier prompts of commit and report tasks: repository CI runs npm run check on ubuntu-latest, so platform-specific tests must guard themselves without weakening the Windows check; copy test summary lines verbatim; and, for verifiers, a test tally or other count in the report that does not match the verifier's own re-run of the same gate at the same head is a blocking finding. Keep every existing prompt rule and the web-task and research-mode prompts unchanged except where these rules apply. Add focused tests in tests/supervisor/executors.test.mjs. Do not touch the controller or any other adapter.
constraints: Change only src/supervisor/adapters/executors.mjs, tests/supervisor/executors.test.mjs and docs/SUPERVISOR.md (section 8, one or two lines).
acceptance: Implementer and verifier prompts for commit and report tasks contain the three rules; web-task (browser) and researchOnly prompts are otherwise unchanged (tested).
Existing executors tests pass unchanged; new tests fail on the task base.
npm run check passes; the PR copies the node:test summary lines verbatim.
